description: A utility module providing a minimal wrapper around the fetch API for making HTTP requests to a configured backend service. It handles scenarios where no backend URL is configured by returning a mock response, and manages request options, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers = {}, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to a configured API base URL with specified options, handling fallback behavior if no backend URL is configured. Supports GET, POST, and other methods, serializes request bodies, and processes JSON or text responses.
